title: The Classification filter stays set after opening a work order and going back
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, flagged as an Internal customer.
  • Have a new internal work order for this test, work order 1, for internal customer A, in status Approved.
custom_steps:
1. Open the work orders list.
  2. Set the "Classification" chip to "Internal".
  3. Open work order 1.
  4. Go back with the browser's Back button.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The list opens.

Step 2:

  • Work order 1 is listed.

Step 3:

  • Work order 1 opens.

Step 4:

  • The list shows "Classification: Internal" still applied.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11759 (Story 2, An internal or no-charge work order from creation to Close)

  • S2-R14: “While the Internal Work Orders setting is on, the work orders list shows a chip "Classification: All / Billable / Internal / No Charge" (the existing single-choice chip), default All, on every tab and in the mobile filter sheet. While the setting is off the chip is not shown; the badges on the rows stay.”

From: "Internal Work Orders technical implementation plan", 2026-10-28, last updated 2026-11-10 (revision 5, built on PRD v1.0), sources/TECH-PLAN-Internal-Work-Orders-upload-2026-11-12.md, read 12 Nov 2026

  • Tech plan line 1434 (TP-151): “After Back, the chip is still active.”
